title: Veo3 request hardcodes audio, person, resize and sample settings; no negative prompt, seed, resolution or audio toggle
summary: Veo3Provider sends generateAudio true, personGeneration allow_adult, resizeMode pad and sampleCount 1, takes aspectRatio from the project, and sends only prompt plus start image and optional lastFrame. No negativePrompt, seed, resolution or per-request audio setting is passed. ImageProviderInterface declares negativePrompt and seed, but the only generateImage call (ImageGenerationService) sets neither.
notes: Veo branch runs only when VIDEO_PROVIDER=veo3 (default is mock). Runtime provider behaviour is UNKNOWN statically.

title: LLM prompt output is hard-sliced to 1200 or 500 characters with a trailing ellipsis
summary: cleanPromptOutput cuts any output longer than maxLength to maxLength-3 characters and appends '...'. Frame, end-frame, continuity and correction prompts use 1200; video prompts use 500. The video template lists SOUND DESIGN as the fourth and last part, so a long output can lose its audio section; no warning or retry is raised.
notes: Extends wave-1 FACT-0115, which records the limits but not the silent cut or its effect on the audio section. Effect on generated content is UNKNOWN statically.

title: Compatible-model tags include Runway Gen-3 and Kling with no integration; tags are persisted and never read by the UI
summary: determineCompatibleModels always returns Veo3, adds 'Runway Gen-3' when the frame prompt is 500 characters or less and the shot has no dialogue, and adds 'Kling' when duration is 10 seconds or less. generate-prompts persists the list to shots.compatible_models. No file under src/ references compatibleModels or compatible_models.
notes: Tags are informational; no video call is routed to either model.

title: Stage 12 unsatisfied-issue routing has no path back to Stage 10 frames
summary: UnsatisfiedDropdown maps visual-continuity to Stage 8, timing and narrative-structure to Stage 7, and dialogue-audio to Stage 9. The optional description is cleared and not stored (wave-1 CAP-0280). No issue type returns to Stage 10 frames.
notes: Relevant to the review routing idea AV-049.

title: Inpaint canvas offers brush and eraser tools only
summary: InpaintCanvas declares tool type 'brush' | 'eraser' with brush default. InpaintingModal is rendered at Stage10FrameGeneration.tsx:1721, so the inpaint path is reachable. No rectangle, ellipse or lasso tool exists.
notes: Mask is stored but not transmitted (wave-1 FACT-0189).

title: voice_profile_id is a persisted free-text column on global assets with no reader
summary: Global assets have a nullable voice_profile_id TEXT column (comment: 'ElevenLabs ID or similar'). The assets CRUD route writes it on create and update. The type is declared in src/types/asset.ts. No prompt, video, frame or UI code reads it, and no voice-service client exists.
notes: Only storage; no voice behaviour exists.

title: Shot-duration validator accepts 1 to 30 seconds; the Veo provider silently clamps to 4, 6 or 8
summary: shotValidationService errors above 30 seconds and warns above 12. Stage 7 extraction defaults to 8 seconds. Veo3Provider clamps any requested duration to the nearest of 4, 6 or 8 with a log line only. Cost is computed from the unclamped shot duration (wave-1 FACT-0127), and the validator never requires a split for shots longer than 8 seconds.
notes: shotValidation.test.ts covers the validator thresholds; the provider clamp is not tested.

title: Reference images are not capped: every reference URL is sent to the provider
summary: executeJobInBackground prepends every referenceImageUrls entry to the provider's reference list with no count limit. No maximum or budget constant appears in the image-generation, frame-generation or prompt-generation services.
notes: Quality effect of large reference sets is UNKNOWN statically.

title: Reference-image load failures fall back to text-only generation with only a console warning
summary: NanoBananaClient downloads each reference separately, counts failures, continues, and when none load proceeds with text context or the base prompt only, logging a warning. Nothing is written to the job, frame or UI, so the user is not told that references were dropped.
notes: Silent degradation path; contradicts the reference-failure surfacing idea GEN-127.

title: Use-as-reference toggle starts OFF in Stage 10 and ON in the shared upload modal used by Stage 8 scene assets
summary: FramePanel's 'Use current image as reference' switch starts false (FramePanel.tsx:170). EnhancedUploadModal's 'Use as ref' switch starts true (EnhancedUploadModal.tsx:106). VisualStateEditorPanel (Stage 8 scene-asset editor) mounts that modal for uploads (VisualStateEditorPanel.tsx:811-812).
notes: Defaults are inconsistent across regeneration points.

title: Video-prompt request omits the shot setting and the scene script
summary: generateVideoPrompt's user message contains shot id, duration, action, camera, dialogue, and foreground and background character lists, plus transformation and presence notes. It does not contain setting or the scene script excerpt. The framePrompt parameter is accepted but unused (wave-1 DEAD-0117).
notes: Limits how sound design can be inferred from scene context (AV-012).

title: Prompt length limits are warn-only in the UI; the server rejects only at the PUT limits
summary: VersionedTextarea colours the counter past warnLength and past maxLength but leaves the field editable and saveable. The PUT route rejects frame prompts over 1500 and video prompts over 1000 characters with HTTP 400. The UI limits differ again (wave-1 FACT-0115).
notes: UI never blocks save at the displayed maximum.

title: Continuity-break warning suppression is a browser localStorage flag
summary: The FramePanel break-link confirmation can be suppressed by a 'Don't show again' checkbox that writes localStorage key skipContinuityBreakConfirm; the flag is read on the next break attempt. Nothing is stored server-side.

title: Render completion is announced by in-app toast only; no email or push sender exists
summary: Stage 12 shows a success or warning toast when all jobs finish, but only while the Stage 12 component is mounted. The video executor has no notify step after completion, and no mailer or outbound notification call exists in backend/src. Scene status is recomputed in the database only.
notes: Absence of email is established by search of backend/src for mailer and send calls; the search is the evidence.
